physicalNotes: Radius 0.595 +/- 0.031 solar radii from Thygesen et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-321 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..155T/abstract): 413,942 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.578 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Thygesen et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-321 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..155T/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3750 +/- 510 K from Thygesen et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-321 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..155T/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
